statement: Modifier latch: short tap applies to the next single key only; a 1.5 s hold locks with a weak vibration; a tap while locked releases.
Only Ctrl, Alt and Shift are lockable and are marked with a corner dot.
The design mock docs/design/mobile-terminal-keyboard.html is the reference for every wave; deviations are asked first.
Win, AltGr, mouse and screenshot keys are excluded.
E2E runs only against https://localhost:2222; processes on TCP 2001/2002 are never stopped.
No Korean literals in frontend/src; every UI string goes through messages.{en,ko}.json.
